attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This changes GraphQL schema-building logic (case-insensitive field collision checks, field routing to part vs content type, renamed public extension class) which the release notes themselves admit can alter existing GraphQL schemas/queries for content types with dynamic fields, so downstream sites/modules may see breaking query changes."}

reason: This changes GraphQL schema-building logic (case-insensitive field collision checks, field routing to part vs content type, renamed public extension class) which the release notes themselves admit can alter existing GraphQL schemas/queries for content types with dynamic fields, so downstream sites/modules may see breaking query changes.
